ANSWER: YES
HALLUCINATIONS:
- States the waiver pertains to “Q4 2024”; the source specifies a waiver for the fiscal quarter ending January 27, 2024 (no “Q4 2024” designation).
- Labels the leverage covenant schedule as “Q1 2024, Q2 2024, Q3–Q4 2024”; the source provides specific fiscal quarter-end dates (January 27, 2024; April 27, 2024; July 27, 2024; October 26, 2024) and does not map them to those quarter labels.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- Exact First Amendment Effective Date (March 6, 2024)
- Definition of the First Amendment Period end point (through delivery of financials and Compliance Certificate for the fiscal quarter ending January 25, 2025)
- Full Applicable Rate pricing grid details, including:
  - Commitment fee percentages by level (0.20%–0.40%)
  - Margins by level for: Term SOFR, Term SOFR Daily Floating Rate and Letters of Credit; Base Rate; Alternative Currency Term Rate; Alternative Currency Daily Rate
  - Initial pricing provision: Pricing Level 2 applies from effectiveness until the Compliance Certificate for fiscal year ending April 27, 2024 is delivered
  - Step-up to Pricing Level 1 if a Compliance Certificate is not delivered when due (upon Required Lenders’ request) until delivered
- CORRA transition specifics for CAD loans:
  - Term CORRA Adjustment: 0.29547% (1-month) and 0.32138% (3-month)
  - Use of Term CORRA Rate as the Relevant Rate for Canadian Dollars
  - CAD Interest Period options limited to one or three months
- Additional leverage-based conditions amended by the First Amendment:
  - Investments (Section 7.02(p)): during the First Amendment Period, pro forma leverage ≤ 3.50x; thereafter at least 0.25x below the maximum covenant
  - Indebtedness (Section 7.03(f)): during the First Amendment Period, leverage ≤ 3.50x; thereafter at least 0.25x below the maximum covenant
  - Restricted Payments (Section 7.07(f)): during the First Amendment Period, pro forma leverage ≤ 3.00x; thereafter at least 0.25x below the maximum covenant
- Qualified Acquisition “Adjustment Period” constraints:
  - 3.75x cap for four quarters applies only after the First Amendment Period
  - At least two fiscal quarters at ≤ 3.25x must occur between Adjustment Periods
  - No more than two Adjustment Periods permitted during the term
- Existence of amendment/arranger and lender fees due at effectiveness (amounts not specified)
